title: Blocks before client exists
description: A block message arrives for a GUID that has no client record yet. The Lambda must create the row with only block fields (no agencia/conta/dac). When the client message arrives later it must fill in the missing fields without erasing the block data.

expect.note: After step 1 the row exists with only block fields. After step 2 client fields are added. Neither domain should erase the other's data.
